description: This Java class 'ServerHitBin' tracks and manages server hit statistics, including request, event, view, entity, and service hits. It maintains total and binned statistics, handles persistence of hit data, and manages hit history for different identifiers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServerHitBin
classes.description: A class for tracking server hit statistics, including counts, timing, and persistence, with support for binned and total statistics.

methods.description: Increments request hit count for a given ID.

methods.description: Increments event hit count for a given ID.

methods.description: Increments service hit count for a given ID.

methods.description: Updates total hit counts since server start for a given ID.
